name: Called by The Tomb, Mass
body:
School necromancy; Level cleric/oracle 7, death mage 7, inquisitor 6, sorcerer/wizard 7, white necromancer ?

DESCRIPTION

Targets one or more humanoid creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions as mass hold person except you manipulate negative energies powering undead creatures to target them. Mindless undead do not get a saving throw to negate this spell or end it early.
